usedFor: Bexio holds your invoices and customers, and Conversion Chats messages them when “New Sales-Invoice” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sales-Invoice” in Bexio, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A fresh invoice tells the customer right away, and the message goes through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: “New Sales-Invoice” also fires on updates, so an edited invoice can send the same template message twice.
